business_problem: Billings Clinic - Logan Health needed to reduce clinician burnout caused by manual, interrupt-driven note taking and EHR documentation so physicians could spend more time with patients and less time completing charts after hours.
solution_summary: Billings Clinic - Logan Health deployed Oracle Health AI Agents as a documentation layer integrated directly with Oracle Health Foundation EHR. The system captures patient-physician conversations, drafts relevant clinical notes, and routes them into existing physician workflows without the complex interfaces common in stand-alone voice tools. Because the AI-generated note stream is embedded in the same EHR environment clinicians already use, the health system can improve documentation speed while keeping clinical information available to other departments sooner. The deployment was evaluated against competing voice-to-note platforms, but Oracle's tight workflow integration and product roadmap made it the preferred option for scaling across a large multisite organization. At production scale, the platform supports thousands of employees and 1,200 physicians across 80 specialties, helping move clinician time back to patient care while improving timeliness and consistency of charting.

solution_components.role: Captures conversations and drafts clinical notes to reduce physician documentation workload.

solution_components.name: Oracle Health Foundation EHR

business_outcome: Billings Clinic - Logan Health reduced documentation burden, increased patient throughput, and improved clinician work-life balance by deploying Oracle Health AI Agents at scale across its multisite rural health system.
